faq.a: Rahama is associated with the Arabic form رَحْمَة, whose core sense is rahama; mercy (hausa form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Rahama?
faq.a: Rahama is associated with Arabic. Rahama is the Hausa form of Arabic رَحْمَة (Raḥma), meaning 'mercy'.
Yes — the underlying form رَحْمَة is Arabic.
Rahama can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
